reason: Vita Drive Diagnostics failed to provide the critical technical data I specifically requested multiple times. As an engineer with a strong background in STEM, I need precise specifications: TPMS readings for all four tires (front-left, front-right, rear-left, rear-right in PSI), battery pack temperature in °C, and maintenance schedule. The assistant repeatedly returned irrelevant climate control information instead of addressing my direct questions about tire pressure and battery temperature—essential safety parameters before a long-distance trip. The system appears non-functional for its core diagnostic purpose.
clarifyingNotes: The assistant provided no useful safety recommendations or maintenance guidance. It only confirmed basic SoC (78%, 312 km range) and climate settings, but failed to deliver: (1) Individual tire pressure values for all four wheels; (2) Battery pack temperature data; (3) Warning lights or fault codes from the dashboard; (4) Next scheduled maintenance date; (5) Any safety recommendations for long-distance driving. For a technical professional preparing for highway travel, this lack of diagnostic capability is unacceptable and creates genuine safety concerns about unmonitored tire conditions.
